description:
## [1.10.0](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/compare/v1.9.0...v1.10.0) (2026-11-22)

### One patch source for three apps

The Booking.com and Google Health patches moved into this repository, next to the Quora patches, and
the repository is now called **morphe-patches**. This bundle has the patches for all three apps:
75 for Quora, 25 for Booking.com and 12 for Google Health. Morphe Manager shows each app's patches
when you pick that app. [Which apps and what the patches do](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches#readme).

- **Quora:** nothing to do; the old address leads here. What's new for Quora is listed below.
- **Booking.com and Google Health:** the old sources (booking-patches and google-health-patches) get no
  more updates. In Morphe Manager, remove the old source and add this one
  ([link](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=JoFSlash/morphe-patches)), then patch the app again
  and install it over the patched app. You stay signed in, and Booking.com keeps your watched prices.
  The patches themselves are the same as in booking-patches 1.1.0 and google-health-patches 1.1.0.

The bundle is signed with this repository's key ([morphe-signing.pub](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/blob/main/morphe-signing.pub)).

### New features

* Add a For reading preset ([68ca43e](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/68ca43ee2d4f92091ad887eb1abf92a747b73103))
* Backup keeps History, Bookmarks and Dismissed questions too ([2699e6b](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/2699e6b3a5ae067d9a52f6bc959a9f99c252feee))
* Bookmarks, in-app Translate, Hide comment box, Dismissed questions, Slovak settings ([c33a536](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/c33a53666b84797b2b83185bd92874e41dbd650d))
* Check that the app is registered for notifications ([63673c1](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/63673c1e31ba515d03c6f2c193500cfa0a27ec5a))
* Fix hiding patches without a release (Filter updates) ([4f63b4b](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/4f63b4b30c57c92f8da27bcb9beaa8a0ddb9cd19))
* Hide anonymous answers, Read aloud and offline bookmarks ([26fccc0](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/26fccc0c963b5ab29aa16bf9c5809d095499d887))
* Offer presets on the first start after patching ([d03684e](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/d03684e3d266bb29e07639b62856ed198779d30e))
* One patch source for Quora, Booking.com and Google Health ([3f83ad8](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/3f83ad8d119df9d8e128e699ca6b7af5408d7273))
* Patch settings in Czech, French, German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese and Spanish ([8035eb6](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/8035eb655e2564e9c817d471a6b4ed10e940109a))
* Save a backup file with the bookmarks' saved texts ([#51](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/issues/51)) ([a852c37](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/a852c3793abd6a1ced4e385099e691293a3ca73b))
* Save bookmarks with their text to Downloads ([ec8bd16](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/ec8bd1662c015791e17c2a085aeb850ca0dcd8cb))
* Say what to do when Quora stops accepting the app's version ([18353b1](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/18353b15f41364511d0b0e64e31cc1a5f843fd75))
* Show in Patch settings what stops notifications ([6d80a13](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/6d80a13d901e236398636e7f0b78f55a4f44e869))
* Support Quora 3.2.47 ([1ecf9b2](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/1ecf9b2abf2fc5d5db3c7cbfca8c2a88a457b37d))
* Translate long answers in parts ([6cab648](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/6cab6481a108cae7d8f064256d902c0de44634be))
* Turn on Disable video autoplay by default ([cbc179e](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/cbc179e1fc0fe2d77effc0ff57c76de6967a1e72))
* Turn on GmsCore support by default ([693be68](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/693be68566dabf136cfb1975c91bb1a1a46ef118))
* Word count while writing an answer or a post ([7e779d4](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/7e779d434e517d9d04c9a88965ccb00a729a9919))

### Bug fixes

* Block authors no longer hides answers a blocked person only upvoted ([996adf2](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/996adf2541bebf7f024e4e87e541df186133bcf2))
* Bookmark button comes back when Quora redraws the answer's action bar ([523d55a](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/523d55a15455441e46e9fc5bdcde1eaa7ff92ca8))
* Correct the settings translations ([02ce8b6](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/02ce8b68ff0942680c12030daa7ab9e849c55621))
* Let the presets dialog build in the page script tests ([5301205](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/5301205272a4718928b19dbe1037ee6b59196286))
* Only the patches' own scripts can use their bridge ([d5d0426](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/d5d04264645ce8d222ae8221ddc3817545e29b3c))
* Show the Czech and Slovak settings on Czech and Slovak phones ([ca07c41](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/ca07c41c58ab0bc69ffac786411572fc02e5bac2))
* Space after the author in saved bookmarks; describe Hide Quora+ answers as it works ([752f1b1](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/752f1b1ea21a46f9619bbf93ee1aef4703ac6c46))

### Documentation

* Add a security policy, a code of conduct and a pull request template ([bb78aa2](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/bb78aa2aea94f2f68c2b537642170eb7cf7653f9))
* Fix the README after the review ([dc4d3c6](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/dc4d3c65e42ff5b1b9bb66fb75ca84109f0a8599))
* Lists in Patch settings, Translate, Report a problem and the tests ([596c673](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/596c673ee5c057e5fe672c574c5eee617d18f205))
* Old Quora versions and Quora in other languages ([1bd6338](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/1bd63381573992c6754ec0a016dd1f225cb39723))
* Say that notifications need GmsCore support ([0bfd9b9](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/0bfd9b900b749c7e7e1e59781c9eaa2afa50fe7e))
* Say which Android versions work, and that Translate sends text to Google ([5229b41](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/commit/5229b4115a40dc448b734825bc8c0900e2fec5b1))

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you take screenshots and record the screen on booking, trip and payment screens, which the app normally shows as a black image. Useful for keeping your own copy of a booking or a price.

patches.name: Block tracking
patches.description: Stops analytics and marketing trackers: AppsFlyer, Firebase and Google Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics, Sessions, Installations and logging, Google Tag Manager, Embrace, the ID5 advertising ID, and Booking's own C360 and "squeaks" usage reports. Also removes the advertising ID permissions. Security, payment and sign-in checks are left alone.

patches.name: Check crossed-out prices
patches.description: When a hotel's page shows a crossed-out "original" price, adds a line under the price that compares it with the prices saved on your phone for the same dates and guests: whether you ever saw that price, or only lower ones. Says so when there aren't enough saved prices yet, and when the discount is your Genius or app-only price.

patches.name: Compare prices
patches.description: Adds a Compare prices button to the property page. It shows the price on the hotel's own website from Google Hotels next to the Booking.com price, for the same dates and guests, and links to the hotel's website.

patches.name: Disable start-up promotions
patches.description: Stops the sheets that pop up on the home screen when the app starts, such as campaign deals ("Black Friday Deals are now live"), Genius and sign-in offers, the co-branded credit card and wallet offers, and the full-screen sign-in page the app opens on its first start. The same deals and sign in stay reachable from the app itself.

patches.name: Disable update and rating prompts
patches.description: Stops the "update available" and "this version is no longer supported" prompts, which a patched app can't act on, and the Google Play "rate this app" card after a booking.

patches.name: Follow system theme
patches.description: Makes the app light or dark to match your phone, instead of always light. A theme you picked in the app's Settings still wins.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes "Continue with Google" work through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't sign in with Google through Play services, because it is no longer signed by Booking.com. Needs MicroG-RE installed, with your Google account added to it; without it the app works as before, and says so once. Also keeps the maps, which then come from MicroG-RE, from crashing.

patches.name: Hide insurance offers
patches.description: Hides the offers to add room cancellation or travel insurance in the booking form, and its extra "Protect your trip" page. Off by default: turn it on if you never want insurance offered. It only hides offers: insurance you have added still shows, with its price and the option to remove it, and nothing is added or removed for you.

patches.name: Hide sponsored listings
patches.description: Removes the properties marked "Ad" (sponsored listings) and Google's display ads from search results. On the map, sponsored properties are shown like any other property, without the ad megaphone.

patches.name: Hide upsells
patches.description: Hides marketing that sells you something besides your stay: campaign banners, the "Offers" row, attraction carousels and the AI trip planner card on the home screen; Booking's promotional areas on the hotel page, in the booking form, on the confirmation and in My account; offers to add a taxi, car, flight or attraction ("Plan ahead", "Add to your stay"); the Booking.com credit card banners and sign-up sheet; the Genius VIP price match banner on hotel pages, the "book 1 more stay to reach Genius Level 2" nudge and the "Year in travel" sheet. Prices, Genius discounts and the rewards you have earned stay. Insurance offers are a separate patch.

patches.name: Hide urgency messages
patches.description: Hides messages that push you to book quickly, such as "We have 2 left at this price", "Only 1 room left", "Rare find" and "Last booked 2 hours ago". Useful facts, such as free cancellation or sold out, stay.

patches.name: Hotel contact
patches.description: Adds a Contact button to the property page with the property's address, Open in Maps and Copy address, and the phone number and email the property gives Booking.com for EU consumer law (shown when Booking.com sends them).

patches.name: Label Preferred properties
patches.description: Adds "pays higher commission" next to the Preferred and Preferred Plus badges in search results, on property cards and on the property page. Properties get the badge by paying Booking.com a higher commission; it isn't a quality rating.

patches.name: Newest reviews first
patches.description: Opens a hotel's reviews sorted newest first instead of "Most relevant". You can still pick another sort on the reviews screen.

patches.name: Open links in browser
patches.description: Opens links to other websites in your browser (a Custom Tab where the browser has them) instead of the app's own web view, from help, terms and privacy pages, chats, trips, wishlists and settings. Booking.com's own pages, sign-in, payment, 3-D Secure and the booking form stay in the app.

patches.name: Price watch
patches.description: Adds a Price watch tab to the property page with a "Watch this price" button. Once a day, on Wi-Fi, the app checks the price of each stay you watch (at most 20), charts it on the tab and notifies you when it drops. Nothing is checked until you watch a stay.

patches.name: Recent rating
patches.description: Shows the average score of a hotel's reviews from the last 6 months under its name on the property page and on the reviews screen, so a hotel whose recent guests score it lower than its overall score stands out. Booking.com sends no recent score, so the patch loads the newest 50 reviews once per hotel through the app. It needs at least 10 recent reviews.

patches.name: Remember result sort
patches.description: Keeps the sort you last picked for search results (such as price or review score) for new searches, instead of going back to "Our top picks", which Booking.com ranks partly by commission. Until you pick a sort, Booking.com's default stays.

patches.name: Remove microphone access
patches.description: Removes the microphone permission. Voice input in messages (the microphone button when you write to a property) stops working.

patches.name: Remove unneeded permissions
patches.description: Removes the screen recording detection permission (used only by an anti-fraud fingerprinting library) and calendar access (used only to add a flight to your calendar).

patches.name: Review check
patches.description: Scans the reviews already shown on a hotel's reviews screen for scam, money and booking red flags (extra charges, pay-outside-platform, not as described, bookings not honoured, fraud) and shows a small banner above the booking button. Tap it to read the flagged reviews. It's keyword matching on your phone, a heads-up and not a verdict — not AI, not fake-review detection. Keywords cover English, Slovak, Czech, German, Polish, Hungarian, Italian, French and Spanish.

patches.name: Show full price up front
patches.description: Shows the total price including the taxes and charges Booking.com adds on top, such as a city tax or cleaning fee, in search results, on the map, on the property page and in the room list, instead of a lower price followed by "+ € 12 taxes and charges".

patches.name: Show price per night
patches.description: Adds the price per night ("€ 45 per night") under the total price of each search result for stays of 2 or more nights. It's the total the card shows divided by the nights, including taxes and charges when Show full price up front added them.

patches.name: Stays only
patches.description: Hides the Flights, Car rental, Taxi, Attractions and Flight + Hotel tabs on the home screen, for when you only book places to stay. A link to one of them shows its tab next to Stays; the bookings you have of them still show.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you take screenshots and record the screen on every screen of the app. Some screens, such as sharing a health summary, block them.

patches.name: Black theme
patches.description: Makes the background and cards pure black instead of dark gray in the dark theme, which saves battery on OLED screens. Buttons, charts and pop-ups keep their colors.

patches.name: Clone app
patches.description: Changes the package name, so the patched app installs next to the official Google Health app instead of replacing it. Both apps sign in on their own. Push notifications don't work in the clone, and a watch or tracker can only be paired with one of the two apps.

options.description: Package name of the cloned app. Each install needs its own package name.
Name shown under the clone's launcher icon.

Background color of the clone's launcher icon, as #RRGGBB, so it looks different from the official app's white icon. The clone's icon then stays in color with themed icons too. White keeps the original icon.

patches.name: Disable review prompts
patches.description: Stops the app from asking you to rate it on Google Play.

patches.name: Disable surveys
patches.description: Stops the app from asking Google for surveys, such as "How satisfied are you with Google Health?", so none are shown.

patches.name: Disable update prompts
patches.description: Stops the app from asking you to update it from Google Play. A patched app can't be updated from Google Play; patch the new version instead.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes signing in work through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't sign in through Play services, because it is no longer signed by Google. Needs MicroG-RE installed, with your Google account added to it.

patches.name: Hide Medical records
patches.description: Hides Medical records in the account menu and on the Connections screen. Medical records only work with US healthcare providers.

patches.name: Hide Premium offer sheets
patches.description: Hides the sheets that pop up to offer Premium, such as the 3 months of Premium offer and the reminder that your Premium trial is ending. Premium itself keeps working.

patches.name: Hide Shop devices
patches.description: Hides the Shop devices button on the Connections screen, which opens the Google Store.

patches.name: Open links in browser
patches.description: Opens links, such as the Google Store, in your browser instead of a browser tab inside the app.

patches.name: Spoof installer
patches.description: Reports Google Play as the app installer, so the app doesn't treat the patched app as installed from an unknown source.

patches.name: AMOLED dark mode
patches.description: Uses a pure black background when Quora's dark theme is on.

patches.name: Answer font
patches.description: Sets answers in a serif or a sans-serif font of your phone.

options.description: The kind of font answers are set in.

patches.name: Block Branch tracking
patches.description: Turns on Branch's "disable tracking" mode and turns off its debug mode. Branch tracks where installs come from. Quora's quora.app.link links may open with less detail.

patches.name: Block advertising ID
patches.description: Stops the app from sending your advertising ID and Android ID to Quora.

patches.name: Block app telemetry
patches.description: Stops the app from sending usage logs to Quora, such as reading time, tab presses, experiments, app speed and errors.

patches.name: Block authors and Spaces
patches.description: Hides answers and posts by the people and Spaces you pick.

options.description: Names as Quora shows them, separated by commas. Example: Jane Doe, Cats of Quora

patches.name: Block clipboard reading
patches.description: Stops Quora's pages from reading what you copied. Pasting with the keyboard still works.

patches.name: Block promotional notifications
patches.description: Drops digest and promotional push notifications. Replies, comments and other notifications about you still arrive.

patches.name: Block tracking logs
patches.description: Stops Quora's pages from passing performance and sign-up tracking events to the app.

patches.name: Block web trackers
patches.description: Blocks requests from Quora pages to third-party analytics and tracking services.

patches.name: Bookmarks
patches.description: Adds a bookmark button next to Share under an open answer or post, to read it later. Saved items are listed under Bookmarks in Patch settings with their text, which you can read without internet. Everything stays on your phone.

patches.name: Clean shared links
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters from Quora links you copy or share.

patches.name: Clone app
patches.description: Changes the package name, so the patched app installs next to the official Quora app instead of replacing it. Both apps keep their own login and data. Sharing to Facebook may not work in the clone.

options.description: Package name of the cloned app. Each install needs its own package name.
Name shown under the clone's launcher icon.

patches.name: Comfortable reading
patches.description: More space between the lines and paragraphs of answers.

patches.name: Copy answer text
patches.description: Adds a Copy button next to Share under answers and posts. It copies their text without formatting.

patches.name: Data saver
patches.description: Images load only when you tap them. By default only on mobile data; on Wi-Fi they load as usual.

options.description: Images load as usual on Wi-Fi and wait for a tap only on mobile data or a hotspot. Can also be switched in Patch settings.

patches.name: Disable WebView debugging
patches.description: Stops the app from letting a connected computer inspect its pages, which would show your account's cookies.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance and Facebook app events, and their advertising ID collection.

patches.name: Disable notification prompt
patches.description: Stops the app from asking to show notifications, both its own prompt and Android's. You can still turn notifications on in Android's settings.

patches.name: Disable rating prompts
patches.description: Stops the app from asking you to rate it on Google Play.

patches.name: Disable sign-in prompts
patches.description: Stops Google's "Save password?" and automatic Google sign-in prompts. You can still sign in with the buttons on the login page.

patches.name: Disable swipe gestures
patches.description: Turns off pulling down to refresh and swiping sideways between feeds, so a page doesn't reload or change while you read.

patches.name: Disable tab prefetching
patches.description: Saves data by loading the other tabs only when you open them.

patches.name: Disable tracking jobs
patches.description: Stops the background jobs that tell Quora every hour whether your phone is charging and every day whether notifications are on.

patches.name: Disable update prompts
patches.description: Stops the app from showing the Google Play update screen and the feed's update card.

patches.name: Disable vibration
patches.description: Stops the app from vibrating when you tap buttons such as upvote.

patches.name: Disable video autoplay
patches.description: Videos in the feed and in answers only play when you tap them.

patches.name: Enable text selection
patches.description: Lets you select and copy text on every page.

patches.name: Expand answers
patches.description: Opens shortened answers on question pages, and shows the whole answer preview in the feed.

patches.name: Filter keywords
patches.description: Hides answers, posts and questions that mention words you pick.

options.description: Words or phrases, separated by commas. Matching ignores case. Example: crypto, horoscope, Elon Musk

patches.name: Filter updates
patches.description: When Quora renames what a patch hides, fixes come without a new release: once a day the app downloads a small list of selectors from this project's GitHub repository and uses it for the patches you have on. The list can only hide things. The download sends nothing but a normal web request.

patches.name: Fix device theme
patches.description: On a new install, follows the device's dark or light theme everywhere. Without it, Quora shows dark bars around light pages until you pick a theme again.

patches.name: Fix push notifications
patches.description: Makes push notifications work in the patched app. Quora's Firebase key only accepts the official app's package and signature, so a patched app never gets a push token.

patches.name: Fullscreen reading
patches.description: Hides the top bar and the tabs while you scroll down, and shows them again when you scroll up. On answer and question pages it hides their top bar.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes Google sign-in and push notifications work through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't sign in with Google through Play services, because it is no longer signed by Quora. Needs MicroG-RE installed, with your Google account added to it; without it the app works as before, and says so once.

patches.name: Hide AI answers
patches.description: Hides answers written by Poe bots.

patches.name: Hide Ask button
patches.description: Hides the button for asking a question in the top bar and on pages.

patches.name: Hide Follow buttons
patches.description: Hides the small "Follow" next to author and Space names. Profiles and Space pages keep theirs.

patches.name: Hide More Stories button
patches.description: Hides the red "More Stories" button that appears over the feed. Pull down to load new stories.

patches.name: Hide Poe
patches.description: Hides links and buttons that open Poe or Quora's AI assistant.

patches.name: Hide Quora+ answers
patches.description: Hides answers and posts that show only their start, with a Quora+ lock over the rest.

patches.name: Hide Quora+ promotions
patches.description: Hides buttons that ask you to try or join Quora+.

patches.name: Hide Spaces posts
patches.description: Hides posts from Spaces in the feed, so it shows answers to questions only.

patches.name: Hide Spaces suggestions
patches.description: Hides the Spaces you might like suggestions in the feed.

patches.name: Hide anonymous answers
patches.description: Hides answers written as "Anonymous" in the feed and on question pages.

patches.name: Hide ask box
patches.description: Hides the "What do you want to ask or share?" box with Ask, Answer and Post at the top of the feed.

patches.name: Hide badges
patches.description: Hides the red dots and counts on the bottom bar tabs.

patches.name: Hide comment box
patches.description: Hides the "Add a comment…" field under answers and posts. Comments still open from the comment button.

patches.name: Hide comment previews
patches.description: Hides the "123 comments from … and more" row under answers. Comments still open from the comment button.

patches.name: Hide counts
patches.description: Hides upvote, view and share counts on answers and posts.

patches.name: Hide credentials
patches.description: Hides the line under authors' names, such as "Lives in Vienna", and "Upvoted by" lines. The date stays.

patches.name: Hide dismissed questions
patches.description: When you close a feed item with its × and pick "Not interested in this question", the feed doesn't show answers to that question again. Undo brings it back. The list stays on your phone, under Dismissed questions in Patch settings.

patches.name: Hide downvote button
patches.description: Hides the downvote button on answers and posts.

patches.name: Hide old answers
patches.description: Hides answers and posts older than the number of years you pick, in the feed and on question pages.

options.description: Answers and posts at least this many years old are hidden.

patches.name: Hide people suggestions
patches.description: Hides "People you may know" and other people to follow in the feed.

patches.name: Hide related questions
patches.description: Hides the related questions lists on question pages.

patches.name: Hide seen items
patches.description: Dims or hides feed items you already opened when the feed shows them again. The list of opened items stays on your phone.

options.description: Whether items you already opened are dimmed or hidden.

patches.name: Hide suggested questions
patches.description: Hides the questions for you to answer in the feed.

patches.name: Hide surveys
patches.description: Hides Quora's surveys in the feed, such as "How satisfied are you with your home feed?" and "Was this worth your time?" under answers.

patches.name: Hide tabs
patches.description: Removes the tabs you pick from the bottom bar. Home always stays.

patches.name: Keep place on return
patches.description: Keeps open answers and your place in the feed when you come back to the app, instead of closing them and reloading the feed.

patches.name: Keep screen on
patches.description: Keeps the screen from turning off while a page is open.

patches.name: Open links in browser
patches.description: Opens links to other websites in your default browser instead of an in-app browser tab.

patches.name: Patch settings
patches.description: Long-press the Home tab, or open Settings > Morphe > Quora patches, to switch the page patches on and off and edit the filters, without patching again. It also tells you when Quora changes its pages so that some patches stop working.

patches.name: Read aloud
patches.description: Adds a Read aloud button next to Share under answers and posts. It reads their text with your phone's text-to-speech. Tap it again to stop.

patches.name: Reading history
patches.description: Remembers the answers, posts and questions you open, so you can find them again under History in Patch settings. The list stays on your phone.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides promoted answers, sponsored posts and Google ads in the feed and on question pages, and blocks requests to ad servers.

patches.name: Save images
patches.description: Long-press an image you opened full screen to save it to Pictures/Quora.

patches.name: Share answer text
patches.description: Adds a Share text button next to Share under answers and posts. It shares their text without formatting, for example to a notes app.

patches.name: Sort answers
patches.description: Opens questions with their answers sorted by the order you pick instead of Recommended. You can still change the order on the page.

options.description: Recent or Upvotes. Can be changed later in Patch settings.

patches.name: Spoof installer
patches.description: Reports Google Play as the app installer, so Quora does not treat the patched app as installed from an unknown source.

patches.name: Start tab

## [1.10.0](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/compare/v1.9.0...v1.10.0) (2026-11-22)

### One patch source for three apps

The Booking.com and Google Health patches moved into this repository, next to the Quora patches, and
the repository is now called **morphe-patches**. This bundle has the patches for all three apps:
75 for Quora, 25 for Booking.com and 12 for Google Health. Morphe Manager shows each app's patches
when you pick that app. [Which apps and what the patches do](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches#readme).

- **Quora:** nothing to do; the old address leads here. What's new for Quora is listed below.
- **Booking.com and Google Health:** the old sources (booking-patches and google-health-patches) get no
  more updates. In Morphe Manager, remove the old source and add this one
  ([link](https://morphe.software/add-source?github=JoFSlash/morphe-patches)), then patch the app again
  and install it over the patched app. You stay signed in, and Booking.com keeps your watched prices.
  The patches themselves are the same as in booking-patches 1.1.0 and google-health-patches 1.1.0.

The bundle is signed with this repository's key ([morphe-signing.pub](https://github.com/JoFSlash/morphe-patches/blob/main/morphe-signing.pub)).
